description: Who airs one event, country by country: the promotion's rights deals merged with the event's own confirmed broadcast listings, with provider, kind (tv, stream, ppv…), link and a worldwide row. Pass a two-letter country code to get that market plus worldwide. Series-aware, so a Contender Series card shows its own deal, not the numbered-card one.

country.description: ISO-3166 alpha-2 code, e.g. "US" — that market plus the worldwide row. Omit for every country.

name: how_to_watch
title: How to watch an event
